description: Shared state machine vectors: every (state, event) pair under the default rules and each rule on its own, plus all rules on. rules lists only the flags that are true. expect is the new state and the effect to persist, or a rejection (unknown pair, or blocked by strict mode). Rust (crates/core/tests/machine_vectors.rs) and TypeScript (web/src/lib/machine.test.ts) must both pass every case.
